name: Parsing the Tome of the Great Maker

system.description: Closing her eyes and assuming a meditative position, the Alchemical clears her mind and attempts to make communion with the Great Maker. Focusing her will, she reaches into her own mind and attempts to unlock the secret knowledge that is stored within. Her hair begins to lift and twist as if buffeted by a great wind, and when her eyes open, lines of Old Realm glyphs flow across them, as if she was accessing the wisdom of ages past and searching through it for divine inspiration. Provided that the weaver has read anything directly from The Tome of the Great Maker, she may weave this protocol to impart knowledge unto herself. For the remainder of the scene, the weaver automatically succeeds at all Academic Knowledge (see Exalted, pp. 132�133) checks as she understands the hidden wisdom written between the lines of text that she has read from The Tome.
